title: record TLS and nginx hardening evidence for the public mirror

files.role: TLS and nginx hardening evidence script
public certificate summary without private key material

criteria: The public mirror has a valid HTTPS endpoint for aios.w33d.xyz and HTTPS becomes the preferred mirror endpoint.
Nginx validates, reloads, serves the mirror on HTTPS, hides server tokens, and emits hardening headers.
HTTP remains read-only compatibility transport during RC7 while future installer/updater work moves to HTTPS.
Directory listing and write methods remain blocked.
TLS hardening does not authorize install, activation, rollback, active slot mutation, production ring mutation, support upload, remote dispatch, signing, private key access, or TUI authority.
The next task is RC7-022 large payload storage policy and external object storage boundary.
